heading: Everything your lead touches, designed on purpose.
intro: Your offer might be worth five figures, but your lead never sees the offer first. They see an ad, a page, a form, a booking screen and a message from a setter, and they decide what you're worth long before the call. I design all of it, so every single step tells them the same thing.
xrayLeadIn: Here's what a coaching funnel actually looks like from the lead's side. Tap any step to see what most programs ship and what I'd ship instead.

touchpoints.name: Landing page
touchpoints.most: A template with five fonts, stock icons and a button every 300 pixels
touchpoints.mine: One clear story, real proof up top and a page that looks like the price of the offer

touchpoints.name: Training or VSL page
touchpoints.most: A video dropped into a white page
touchpoints.mine: A page that frames the video, holds attention and sets up the application

touchpoints.name: Application form
touchpoints.most: A default Typeform with the logo in the corner
touchpoints.mine: A branded form with fewer, sharper questions that qualifies without feeling like an interview

touchpoints.name: Booking page
touchpoints.mine: A booking step that matches the brand and reminds them why they applied

touchpoints.name: Confirm your call
touchpoints.mine: A short page with one job, getting them to confirm and show up

touchpoints.name: Pre-call prep page
touchpoints.mine: A page the setter sends that warms them up, answers objections and builds trust before the call

touchpoints.name: Reminders
touchpoints.most: Plain text emails and WhatsApp messages
touchpoints.mine: Written and designed reminders that feel personal and cut no-shows

touchpoints.name: Offer and call deck
touchpoints.mine: A clean offer page or deck the closer can screen-share with confidence

touchpoints.name: Onboarding
touchpoints.most: A welcome email with five links
touchpoints.mine: A guided onboarding flow, so day one feels like they joined something serious

touchpoints.name: Skool community
touchpoints.most: A default banner and blank classroom covers
touchpoints.mine: A banner, course covers and an about page that feel like a real brand

touchpoints.name: Wins and reviews page
touchpoints.mine: A proper wall of results people actually want to scroll

touchpoints.name: Internal tools
touchpoints.mine: Custom dashboards, calculators, quizzes and coach pages built around how your team works

xrayOutro: Count how many of these you've actually designed. Most programs I look at have properly designed two or three of them. Fixing the other nine doesn't need a new offer, new ads or more content. It just needs someone who cares about the details.

capabilities.title: Landing pages and funnels.
capabilities.body: Designed and built in Framer or Webflow, fast, responsive and easy for your team to edit.

capabilities.title: Application and onboarding systems.
capabilities.body: Typeform and custom forms, confirmation pages, pre-call pages and the whole flow in between.

capabilities.title: Custom coded tools.
capabilities.body: Dashboards, calculators, quizzes, coach booking apps and anything else your team keeps doing in spreadsheets.

capabilities.title: Brand and identity.
capabilities.body: Logos, type, colour and a small system so everything you make looks like it came from the same place.

capabilities.title: Community design.
capabilities.body: Skool banners, course covers, about pages and the small things that make members feel at home.

capabilities.title: Content and products.
capabilities.body: Playbooks, PDFs, slide decks and lead magnets that look worth paying for.

capabilities.title: Copy.
capabilities.body: I write the words too, because a well designed page with weak copy is still a weak page.

capabilities.title: Motion and interaction.
capabilities.body: Small animations that make things feel finished, never ones that slow you down.
